items: Write view now shows your actual pages, with the same breaks, headers and footers as your PDF.
Zoom in and out of Write view as smoothly as the page view, with Ctrl and + or -, or a pinch.
One Add button for maths, citations, footnotes, tables, charts and pictures.
Find them in Add, in the Insert panel and by typing /footnote or /cite.
The cover designer and print preview take you back to where you were writing.
Problems show the section they are in, and charts with a wrong column still build.
Footnotes no longer count toward your words, like the IB rules.
